title: Aureline benchmark threshold-change record and change ledger
description: Boundary schema for the typed threshold-change workflow. A threshold-change record is the canonical, reviewable identity of one transition in a protected metric's bar: which metric and threshold file it moves, the change kind and resulting threshold state, whether it loosens the protected bar, its structured rationale and comparability note, its before/after evidence packet, its owner, its approval lineage, its waiver grant (class, owner-resolvable ref, grant date, and expiry), its release-evidence linkage, and its lifecycle status. The change ledger is the checked-in collection of those records that binds the threshold history of every protected metric and exposes the active waivers and expiry dates that shiproom and release packets surface. Easing a protected bar requires structured before/after evidence, a comparability note, release-evidence linkage, and both the performance-owner and architecture-board approvals; a non-default waiver requires its granting authority's approval and an expiry; and an open, in-force waiver past its expiry blocks promotion. Raw run logs, raw provider payloads, raw machine labels, and secret material never cross this boundary; only stable ids and reviewable sentences do.

reviewable_sentence.description: Short product-term sentence safe for product copy, docs, support export, and release evidence. Raw run logs, raw provider payloads, raw machine labels, and secret material MUST NOT appear.

change_kind.description: set_calibrated freezes a calibrated bar; tightened hardens it; eased_with_evidence widens it; provisional_hold parks a not-yet-calibrated bar below a claim-bearing level; recalibration_reset resets comparability after a hardware or lab-image recalibration.

change_status.description: active marks the single in-force record for a metric; superseded and withdrawn are closed history; proposed and approved are pending records not yet in force.

evidence_ref.description: Stable or repo-relative pointer to the run/evidence packet that backs this side of the change; never a raw run log body.

waiver_ref.description: Owner-resolvable id for the waiver decision record; null only when class is none.

expires_on.description: Hard expiry; an open, in-force waiver past this date blocks promotion. Null only when class is none.

metric_ref.description: Protected-metric id this change moves; must resolve in the governance matrix.

threshold_ref.description: Pointer to the governed threshold value (e.g. artifacts/bench/protected_metrics.yaml#ff.command_parity).

loosens_protected_bar.description: True only when the change widens the protected bar; an easing must set this true and carries the stricter approval and evidence requirements.

release_evidence_ref.description: Release-evidence packet that carries this change; required for an easing.

source_refs.description: Schema and governance refs. MUST include this schema and the governance matrix it binds to.

matrix_ref.description: Governance matrix whose protected-metric threshold states and waivers this ledger keeps honest.
